description: diSurface is the pure infrastructure base surface of diUIRender. It holds only the render API and status value; it has no Draw() implementation and reads no CAN or shared-memory signal, so it never renders any layer on its own and yields no visible state.

can.desc: HUD_Safe_Driving_Assistant_Fusion_Switch_Settings_S: ADAS fusion master switch ON (gating signal present, nothing rendered)

mem.desc: power on; base surface still renders nothing because it has no drawable content
